memberdef.name: UseSourceFilenameForPromotedLocals

briefdescription.para: Uses the "source_filename" instead of a Module hash ID for the suffix of promoted locals during LTO.

detaileddescription.para: NOTE: This requires that the source filename has a unique name / path to avoid name collisions.
